text_block_list.name: Santa Claus
text_block_list.text: Ho ho ho ho!

text_block_list.name: Santa Claus
text_block_list.text: A joyous day to you, Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Santa! Hello... Oh,
right. It's already the
holiday season.

text_block_list.name: Santa Claus
text_block_list.text:
I've got a card and a present with your
name on 'em.

text_block_list.name: Santa Claus
text_block_list.text: I'm off then! Have a merry one! Ho ho ho!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, thanks!
I'm sure you've got a lot more
work to do, but I'll be
cheering for you!
Now then...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Oguri Cap,
You are formally invited
to our year-end holiday party.
From your
fans"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A holiday party...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That would be so uplifting! Oh, the
present... Hm, it's from the URA?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Gasp! This is...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"With permission from Tracen, your fans
have volunteered to prepare
a delicious
feast and throw a party to help raise your
racing spirits."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A feast! "We would be delighted if this
event leaves you encouraged for your next
race. If possible, please attend in this
signature
racewear."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sigh... "We look forward to seeing you." Yeah... Me too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So you're invited to a party that's being
held by your fans.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hayahide... Uh, how'd you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... Well, you just said so out loud.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Though you seemed to pause at the
mention of your racewear. Is
something the
matter?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the URA once told me they
were making new signature
racewear for
me, in honor of my achievements.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've heard. Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. But the design wasn't finished at
all... They told me they had
the perfect
idea to help after seeing me fret about
it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the plan was for the fans to
come up with designs. They
got quite a
few made with me in mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They showed them to me, and they're
really cool... I just had to ask if
they'd let
me use one of the designs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's something. So you're going to
attend a fan party in racewear
that
embodies their enthusiasm for you... Isn't
that simply wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really makes me happy. I mean,
I'm happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Something's wrong with me recently. My
races haven't been going as
well as I
thought they would.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even in important races,
I couldn't give the
people watching me what they deserve.
They believed in my ability,
but I let them all down...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still,
they thought up a stunning design for
me to wear on the track. It
makes me...
Well, I don't know how to put it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, you're excited for the
party and happy with the racewear they
made, but you're saddened... that you
haven't repaid
them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah.
That's what I feel! But how'd you
know? Just like Tama...
but no Kansai
accent. Maybe it's the glasses?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Er, glasses? I-I was merely conjecturing.
Anyway, your fans must have
a strong
desire to cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And it's all because you appeal to them so
much. The intention they
have with this
party is purely to encourage you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you set racing aside for the
moment and really enjoy yourself there? I
surmise that would be the best way to
repay their consideration. Well then, have
a happy holiday.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! You too, Hayahide! ...I can
repay their consideration, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
It's a special holiday after all.
I'd love to give them a
great present too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But... what would be good? This season's
known for... chicken over
rice, turkey,
stew, fries, simmered fish...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Salad, pasta, sautés, steamed buns,
borscht... Things with difficult
names,
things with fun names...

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Oguri! Hey, everyone! Oguri just got
here!
Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! Where am I? There's turkey, and
even chicken over rice!

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text: We're right in the middle of preparing for the party! But oh my gosh, Oguri! That racewear! Sniffle! It looks amazing on you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Y-you're just... so cool! Sob!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Uh... Wh-why are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: You see, everyone here had a hand in designing it! And now that you're actually here, wearing it, I just... Cry!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You designed it... To tell the truth,
I was
shocked when I first saw
it—to think that
you felt so strongly about me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. This present that you've given
me... makes me really
happy.

text_block_list.name: Child Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Oguri. We worked really hard too! We made a big star for the tree outside! It's huge!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The tree outside... Ah, you mean the one
that's even bigger than this
cabin! But I
didn't see any decorations on it...

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text:
We made it just about as large as a real
star! It's taking some extra
time to bring it
up the mountain, but don't worry! It'll be
up before the party starts!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Thanks so much, everyone. This is
all so exciting. I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I didn't bring anything...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if anyone will mind if I step out
for a moment. I just... really
want to see
the snow.

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
Feel free to take a stroll until
the party starts! I'm sure it'll
be fine, but
do take care. The weather on these
mountains tends to be a bit blustery!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This is bad...
I need to find a present for
them, fast!
Hm? Say, is that...
